subject.title: fix #101083: fix IRC fatal reconnect status honesty

question: Should this PR land as the status-only slice while IRC fatal-reconnect retry/backoff policy remains open?
rationale: The code path and proof support the status fix, but marking `running: false` changes how health/readiness surfaces treat IRC reconnect failures before the broader retry policy is settled.

options.title: Land status-only slice
options.body: Accept the immediate status/readiness honesty change and leave retry/backoff or terminal-failure policy to the linked issue.

options.title: Preserve task-running semantics first
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps monitor-task `running` separate from transport `connected` while still making status surfaces unavailable on reconnect failure.

options.title: Wait for full policy fix
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose and implement the capped-retry versus terminal-failure behavior in one change.

recommendation.title: Land status-only slice
recommendation.body: Accept the immediate status/readiness honesty change and leave retry/backoff or terminal-failure policy to the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He validated and merged the adjacent IRC lifecycle reconnect change and is the clearest history-backed owner for this follow-up policy choice.
